summary: FVCBankcorp, Inc. filed an 8-K with Items 2.02 and 8.01 to furnish a press release reporting record Q2 2026 earnings — net income of $8.2M (up 45% YoY), diluted EPS of $0.45 — and to declare a $0.07/share cash dividend payable August 17, 2026. The filing also notes a one-time pre-tax gain from the completed sale of its interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party. As a routine earnings release with an ordinary dividend declaration, this is not a special situation; it does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category. No deal terms are present.
